description: Reads the live network, the stream and protocol order state: sellers online, RPC health, stuck orders, projects, Lambda Studio, Twigster. For your own account use taifoon_account. Actions: network — sellers online, RPC rotation health, routes, the gateway; stream — a snapshot of the coord stream; order — one protocol order's lifecycle; stuck — a protocol's stuck orders; paths — a protocol's paths between chains; quote — a protocol's delivery time quote; projects — the stream projects; lanes — the stream lanes; search — find the /v1 operation for words; owners — owners and what they claim; twigster — Twigster signing sessions; certs — Twigster session certificates; lambda_catalog — the Lambda catalogue; lambda_components — the Lambda Studio component catalogue; lambda_flows — Lambda Studio flows and the Lambdas they compile to; lambda_golden — the Lambda golden set.

action.description: what to do (default network): network | stream | order | stuck | paths | quote | projects | lanes | search | owners | twigster | certs | lambda_catalog | lambda_components | lambda_flows | lambda_golden

api_key.description: your tfr_ key (optional for keyless reads) (actions: stream, order, stuck, paths, quote, projects, lanes, search, owners, twigster, certs, lambda_catalog, lambda_components, lambda_flows, lambda_golden)

chain.description: components serving one caip-2 chain (actions: lambda_components, lambda_golden)

dst.description: destination chain id (actions: stuck, paths, quote)

kind.description: components of one kind (quote, route, settle, release, venue, market-making, agent-tool, payment, read, stream, abi) (actions: lambda_components)

protocol.description: path parameter :protocol (actions: order, stuck, paths, quote)

reason.description: one of the protocol’s reasons (see reasons[]) (actions: stuck)

src.description: source chain id (actions: stuck, paths, quote)

name: taifoon_observe
title: Observe the layer
